### About Me

I am a researcher with an interest in epigenetics, chromatin regulation, and how cellular metabolism shapes the aging process.\
My recent work examined **activity-dependent histone PTM dynamics** using quantitative mass spectrometry, where I explored trends in acetylation loss and methylation recovery following neuronal activation.

I enjoy integrating **experimental biology** with **bioinformatics**, and I am currently expanding my skills through projects involving R, data analysis, and clinical data pipelines.
